name: Third-Party Notice of Records Appeal and Proof to Office of Open Records
description: Notice to affected employees, third parties or contractors of an appeal involving their records, followed by proof of that notice to the state Office of Open Records.
recipient: Affected third parties; PA Office of Open Records
deadline: within seven (7) business days of any appeal; proof within seven (7) business days of sending notice
quote: The Open Records Officer shall also provide proof of such notice to the Office of Open Records within seven (7) business days of sending the third party notification.
